title: Expiry, Revocation and Forfeiture of Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes
content:
A product of Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes comes to an end by expiry or by revocation, and its remaining trips are then forfeited.

## Expiry

A certificate or pass still active at the end of its book-by date expires on the following day and its remaining trips are forfeited in one forfeiture entry; trips already booked are unaffected.

| Hypothetical product, book-by date 31 July, still active with trips remaining | Status |
|---|---|
| On 31 July | active; trips may still be booked that day |
| On 1 August | expired; the remaining trips are forfeited in one forfeiture entry |

## Revocation

A certificate or pass is revoked when the product provides for revocation on membership closure and the holder's Summit membership is closed, and its remaining trips are forfeited; a certificate issued in error is revoked before it becomes active.

## Forfeiture

A forfeiture is booked only on a certificate or pass whose status is expired or revoked, as shown on its record.

| Status of the certificate or pass | Forfeiture may be booked |
|---|---|
| expired | yes |
| revoked | yes |
| issued, active or used | no |

## No revival by an agent

Expired or revoked products are never reinstated, extended or reissued by a support agent, except through the irregular-operations extension of the cancellation rule for a trip Crestline cancelled.
